## Summary
- Raise the Sphinx docs lockfile to patched GitPython 3.2.0, PyJWT 2.15.1, tornado 6.5.10, and urllib3 2.8.0.
- Add minimum versions in `docs/sphinx/requirements.in` so a later compile does not drop back into the vulnerable ranges.
- Clears the 21 open Dependabot alerts on `docs/sphinx/requirements.txt`.

## Test plan
- [ ] Confirm Dependabot closes the open alerts for GitPython, PyJWT, tornado, and urllib3 after this merges.
- [ ] Docs install still resolves: `uv pip compile docs/sphinx/requirements.in --python-version 3.10 --output-file docs/sphinx/requirements.txt` produces no further version changes.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
